answer: A newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it, locking 61 POA that is slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 12 epochs. The jade of the register names the voucher for every alias, so a farm's whole sponsor ladder is visible at once; the delta of a conviction climbs the chain, and the crystal of slashed bonds pays the auditors who caught it. No honest sponsor risks real money on a stranger, so 715 fakes need 715 bought sponsors.
